messages.content: Rafael: Anyway, I have to run, I'm picking up my sister from the airport at six. Talk soon!
Ingrid: Ha, true. Oh, I signed up for a bread baking workshop this Saturday, so wish me luck. How was your week?
Tomas: It's been hectic, honestly. We're moving to a smaller apartment near the river next month, so boxes everywhere. Anyway, how's the garden?
Beatriz: Bom, preciso ir, vou jantar com o pessoal do coral hoje. Depois a gente conversa!
Thanks, that helps. By the way, I'm flying to Lisbon on Thursday for a conference, so I'll be offline a bit.
Ingrid: I know, right? It's so relaxing. Lately I've been listening to a podcast called "Slow Rivers" on my commute, it's lovely.
Tomas: The repairs took forever but she floats again! We named the boat Marigold after my grandmother's favorite flower.
Rafael: The whole menu was great, but honestly my favorite will always be mushroom risotto. Creamy and simple, can't beat it.
Beatriz: Music has always been my thing. I play the cello, the ukulele and a little bit of piano, mostly at home.
Ingrid: Same here, it's been a lot. Oh, and we adopted a second rabbit, Pepper, last week. Anyway, enough about me!
Beatriz: Que bom! Eu estou relendo "O Quinze", da Rachel de Queiroz, é um dos meus livros preferidos.
Rafael: Sounds like your back is killing you. Have you thought about trying a standing desk? It helped me a lot.
Tomas: Hmm, maybe. I'll look into it.
Ingrid: If the cake keeps sinking, try lowering the oven to 160 degrees and don't open the door for the first half hour.
Beatriz: Oh, good tip, thanks!
Tomas: When you pick a used bike, check the chain for rust, make sure the brakes grip evenly, and ask for the service history.
Rafael: That's really useful, thank you.
Beatriz: Se a insônia continuar, experimenta deixar o celular fora do quarto e tomar um chá de camomila antes de deitar.
Ingrid: Vou tentar, obrigada!

Tomas: Thanks for asking, it means a lot. It's been an emotional few weeks, lots of ups and downs, and I'm grateful for friends like you. The good news is I finally passed my diving certification, so the trip to the reef is on. I still feel a bit overwhelmed, though.
Rafael: You're right, balance matters. Speaking of which, I sprained my wrist two weeks ago, so climbing is off for a while. Still, I'm trying to stay positive and keep busy.

Ingrid: Obrigada pelo carinho, de verdade. Foram semanas difíceis, mas estou me sentindo mais leve. Ah, consegui a vaga de bibliotecária na escola do bairro, começo em março! Mas ainda estou meio ansiosa com tudo.
Rafael: I'm really into jazz and old soul records.
Ingrid: Nice! I mostly listen to podcasts.
Tomas: I started a new job as a ferry mechanic last Monday.
Beatriz: Eu comecei a aprender cerâmica no mês passado.
Rafael: Hey! Good to hear from you, how have you been?
Ingrid: Aw, thank you so much, that really means a lot to me.
Tomas: Hahaha verdade, né? Que bom te ver animada assim!
